description: Send a message from the brand’s LINE Official Account to ONE person: text (up to 5,000 characters), a picture (JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB) or a video (MP4, up to 200 MB). Anything over a limit is REFUSED with the limit, never cut or converted. TWO KINDS, decided by time: inside a minute of the person’s own message it goes as a REPLY, which is free; otherwise it is a PUSH message, which uses one message of the account’s monthly LINE quota (line_quota reads the quota and what is used). LINE bills that quota to the account on its own plan; Hermoso charges nothing. The answer says which of the two it was. To ANSWER someone who wrote in, read_line_inbox (or list_inbox + reply_to_inbox_item) shows the conversation first. THIS REACHES A REAL PERSON, so it is confirm-gated: show the user the exact message and who it goes to, get an explicit yes, then call again with confirm:true. LINE does not report delivery, and it accepts a message to someone who blocked the account without delivering it, so never tell the user it was delivered. LINE has no API for LINE VOOM, so this is messages only: never offer to post to LINE. Free, 0 credits.

confirm.description: REQUIRED true: this sends a real message to a real person

imageUrl.description: a picture, JPEG or PNG up to 10 MB: a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

text.description: the message text, up to 5,000 characters

to.description: the person’s LINE user id: the letter U followed by 32 characters, shown on every conversation in read_line_inbox. 1:1 only; group and room ids are not taken

videoUrl.description: a video, MP4 up to 200 MB: a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

name: send_line_message
title: Send a LINE message
